run_bench_fwd_bwd: run the SM90 forward and backward benchmark for forward and backward passes across headdims 64, 96, 128
run_sweep_tiles: run the SM90 forward benchmark sweeping tile sizes across multiple headdims and sequence lengths
run_sweep_rs_overlap: run the SM90 forward benchmark sweeping register-spilling and intra-warp-group overlap combinations
run_compare_configs: run the SM90 forward benchmark comparing old versus new tile configuration performance
run_sweep_bwd_opts: run the SM90 backward benchmark sweeping optimization variants like V_in_regs and mma_dkv_is_rs
